line.comment: * Task 0.
* AI looters don't go in Unknown sectors.
* Salvage Crew.
* Expanded 2.2: Looter routing and danger checks.
* Initialize variables used by subroutines to satisfy MSCI's compiler checks.
* Mordan5 - Use the Outpost trade range when the configured looter range is -1.
* Expanded 2.2: Re-sort candidate sectors from the looter's current position.
* don't go to sectors with races we are at war with.
* The sector must be monitored.
* The sector cannot be blacklisted.
* Hard cargo limit.
* Expanded 2.2: Do not begin another sector with a significant load already aboard.
* Return home once at least 25% of the cargo bay is occupied.
* Is another looter already going there?
* Expanded 2.2: Use the same search delay for player and AI looters.
* Before rushing home and starting the loop from the very beginning again, lets at least check to see if we have a bunch of space in our cargo hold.
* Continue salvaging while more than 75% of the cargo bay is free.
* Expanded 2.2: Perform the danger scan only after finding salvage.
* Enter the sector before selecting salvage so Find.Nearest can be used.
* Setting destination is also what tells another looter this sector is spoken for, through the
* mayhem_goingLooters test above.
* Mission purposes.
* Zero Hour Mod: NPC Looters can pickup blacklisted Waste
* Skip wares that do not fit instead of abandoning the sector.
* An attacked looter abandons salvage and banks its cargo.
* AI recycles. Because he's a good boy.
* $t = [THIS] + ' in ' + [SECTOR] + ' has stopped working.'
* START [NULL]-> call script 'Joubarbe.Lib.Infobox': text=$t icon=29 timeout=0 fadeout=0
* sort array is ascending, so the nearest candidate ends up at index 0 and the caller takes it
* from the front. That is the opposite end from Mayhem.GetReachableSectors, which returns its
* own list closest-LAST.
* Check actual hostiles (3+ hostiles or 1 M6+ enemy) rather than hardcoded enemy races.
* Player and AI looters use the same danger checks.
* A single big ship (M6 or larger) makes the sector unsafe.
* Anything that has already hit us, or that has us as its attack target inside 20km, counts.
* Ported from Mayhem.Cmd.ScanNearbyAsteroids in FoF, which had the only working version of this.
